newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat Podravka to spend HRK 100 mln on advertising.
newsitem.headline: Croat Podravka to spend HRK 100 mln on advertising.

text.p: Croatia's leading food processor Podravka said on Monday it planned an aggressive marketing campaign to promote its strategic products at home and abroad.
"We plan to spend over 100 million kuna ($20 million) in 1997 on advertising and self-promotion," public relations manager Zvonko Mrsic told Reuters by telephone.
"This is almost four percent of estimated sales."

This year's emphasis abroad will be on promoting Vegeta, food seasoning that made Podravka famous throughout Central and Eastern Europe, as well as on powdered baby food and instant soups, Mrsic said.
In Croatia, Podravka will also include other food products such as jams and processed vegetables in regular campaigns.
The company said last month it was still working on a marketing vision for cosmetics and human drugs produced by its wholly-owned pharmaceutical unit Belupo.
The campaigns will be mounted in countries with expanding markets where it has its own registered companies -- Hungary, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Russia and Australia, Mrsic said.
Podravka works with Young Rubicon and FCB Publicis on advertising abroad and has its own agency Apel in Croatia. But it is now considering a joint venture with FCB, he added.
Germany, which like Australia has a large Croat community with a taste for Podravka's products, may also be included.
But the former Yugoslav republics of Bosnia-Herzegovina, Slovenia and Macedonia, which absorbed one third of its $132 million 1996 exports, will not be neglected.
In dollar terms exports rose four percent and represented one third of total 1996 sales.
This year's sales are pencilled in at roughly three billion kuna, with the same portion of exports but a precise business plan has yet to be adopted, Mrsic said.
Podravka's stock was last traded at 350 kuna on the Zagreb Stock Exchange, up from 231 at the end of 1996. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
